title: ShopLoom hosted evaluation — deployment preference and quickstart asks
text:
ShopLoom hosted evaluation — deployment preference and quickstart asks

["From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
To: Lina Park <lina@shoploom.com>, Daniel Park <daniel@shoploom.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 1 Nov 2028 15:02:00 -0500
Subject: ShopLoom hosted evaluation — deployment preference and quickstart asks

Hi Lina / Daniel —

Great to meet today — quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned on deployment mode and pilot scope. I focused this on the Hosted API pathway since that was your initial preference, but I included the Dedicated/Private tradeoffs we discussed.

Recap from our call
- Workload: user-facing product recommendations (inference on product descriptions + real-time personalization). Estimated peak QPS: ~40 requests/sec per region; average 18–20 QPS.
- Latency target: p95 generation <400ms for short prompts (<=256 tokens).
- Data sensitivity: product metadata + PII-free user prefs. Security team will still ask for SOC2 evidence and data retention controls.
- Deployment ask: prefer Hosted pilot to get live traffic quickly; evaluating Dedicated if throughput/latency or residency concerns tighten.

Questions / quick asks for ShopLoom ops/security (helps us scope the trial)
1) Confirm pilot traffic slice (daily and peak QPS) you want us to provision for the sandbox.
2) Any hard residency/compliance constraints that would rule out Hosted (we can offer VPC/private plane if needed).
3) Expected concurrency per API key (we'll map to endpoint rate caps).

What we propose for a Hosted quickstart
- Sandbox endpoints (region: us-east-1) + prefixed KV caching enabled for product description prefixes.
- Rate window: start with 60 QPS burstable to 120 QPS for the pilot, steady 20–40 QPS.
- Corresponding token budget estimate attached (we'll refine after you confirm average prompt lengths).

Next steps / owners
- Lina: confirm traffic slice + any residency blocks (reply by EOD Thu).
- Daniel: share SOC2 checklist / security contact (attach questionnaire if you have one).
- Karthik (cc): will propose concrete sandbox endpoints and ratecaps after we get traffic numbers.
- Naomi: schedule 30-min ops walk-through next week and share demo recording.

Attachments: rateplan_proposal.csv (initial token / cost estimate) — will refine once you send sample prompt sizes.

Thanks —
Naomi Feldman
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
naomi@redwood.com | (415) 555-0122
", 'From: Lina Park <lina@shoploom.com>
To: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>, Daniel Park <daniel@shoploom.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 2 Nov 2028 10:16:00 -0800
Subject: Re: ShopLoom hosted evaluation — deployment preference and quickstart asks

Thanks Naomi — quick answers inline and attaching our SOC2 request so you can point us to evidence.

> 1) Pilot traffic slice
We can start with a conservative slice: 10 QPS steady, with verified bursts to 50 QPS for high-traffic windows. Daily active users for the slice ~60k/day.

> 2) Residency/compliance
Not a hard block — Hosted is fine for the pilot, but security wants to validate retention controls and access logs before we move to production.

> 3) Concurrency per API key
We expect client-side concurrency up to 8 concurrent requests per key during bursts.

We also want a back-of-envelope monthly committed cost for Dedicated capacity so we can compare. Can someone send a quick estimate?

Attaching: shoploom_security_questionnaire.pdf (SOC2 checklist)

—Lina
Lina Park
Head of Product Operations, ShopLoom
lina@shoploom.com
', "From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Lina Park <lina@shoploom.com>, Daniel Park <daniel@shoploom.com>
Cc: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 3 Nov 2028 11:05:00 -0500
Subject: Re: ShopLoom hosted evaluation — deployment preference and quickstart asks

Lina — thanks for the details, this helps. A few concrete configuration notes for the Hosted sandbox and a quick Dedicated estimate for comparison.

Hosted sandbox (recommended initial config)
- Region: us-east-1 endpoint: https://api.redwood.com/v1/shopsandbox/shoploom
- Endpoint type: generation endpoint (chat-style) + separate embedding endpoint for similarity retrieval.
- Rate caps: per-key steady 12 QPS, burst window to 60 QPS (short bursts allowed). Given your 8 concurrent client requests, this maps safely to the steady/burst plan.
- Concurrency handling: recommend 6 server-side worker threads with continuous batching to keep p95 <400ms for <=256 tokens.
- Caching: enable prefix / KV caching for product description templates — expect 20–30% token cost reduction for repeat prefixes.

Dedicated ballpark (monthly committed)
- For sustained 40 QPS with p95 <300ms we estimate a starting commit equivalent to a 4-GPU pool; monthly list ~ $XXk (I'll follow up with a precise quote from sales).

Attachments: rateplan_proposal.csv (breakdown per-token estimate and suggested rate windows).

If Hosted looks fine for the pilot, we'll provision the sandbox endpoint and apply the initial ratecaps above. Naomi, can you lock a 30-min ops call next Tue to run through traffic shaping and the SOC2 items?

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Principal Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
karthik@redwood.com
", "From: Naomi Feldman <naomi@redwood.com>
To: Lina Park <lina@shoploom.com>, Daniel Park <daniel@shoploom.com>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 5 Nov 2028 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: ShopLoom hosted evaluation — deployment preference and quickstart asks

Perfect — thanks Lina and Karthik. Quick wrap and proposed schedule:

1) We will provision Hosted sandbox in us-east-1 with the endpoints and rate windows Karthik called out (steady 12 QPS / burst 60 QPS).
2) ShopLoom to return the SOC2 questionnaire (Lina attached on Thu) — we'll have our security team fill the evidence items by EOD Wed.
3) Naomi to run ops walkthrough: Tue Nov 6, 11:00 AM PT — 30 minutes. Agenda: endpoint keys, ratecaps, prefix caching, and sample prompt shapes. Please tell me if that time doesn't work.
4) Sales follow-on: provide a compact Dedicated cost card in 48 hours (Marissa will own the quote).
5) Deliverables: sandbox endpoints + demo recording link below; rateplan CSV attached.

Demo recording: https://drive.google.com/drive/fake-demo-recording
HubSpot: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/record/23097

Attachments included in thread: shoploom_security_questionnaire.pdf, rateplan_proposal.csv

See you Tuesday —
Naomi
